rule: candidate iff the one-sided exact McNemar test finds no statistically detectable accuracy degradation (p>=0.05), the one-sided paired Wilcoxon test supports a positive EIL_post gain (p<0.05), and mean EIL_post gain is positive; rank candidates by mean EIL_post gain; efficiency breaks ties only
accuracy_gate_direction: b > c, where b=A0 correct/arm wrong and c=A0 wrong/arm correct
decision_note: The two-sided McNemar p-value is also reported for transparency but is not the no-degradation gate: a significant accuracy improvement must not disqualify an arm as an accuracy cost.
